content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Mesa

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus project hours, or alternative combinations. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can help verify your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend synchronous sessions on your schedule—no travel required. All instruction covers PMI's current framework, domains, and exam content, preparing you thoroughly for certification.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your formal application, documenting your education and project experience as required. Pay the PMI examination fee. Granite PM Academy's team can guide you through the application portal and answer questions about eligibility documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to solidify your readiness. Schedule your exam with PMI's testing partner. Test virtually or at a local center; Granite PM Academy's support continues right up to exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, conference attendance, volunteering, or published work. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and retain your credential.
